newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500 reaches contract, all-time high.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500 reaches contract, all-time high.

text.p: Chicago Mercatile Exchange June Standard and Poor's 500 futures set a fresh record and contract high at 829.00 late in the session, wiping out the old top at 827.80 set February 19.
Traders said June began its rally late in the session as Nasdaq 100 futures perked up from early losses and rallied to the highest price since early February.
A dim Treasury bond futures tone had stifled S&Ps gains earlier in the day, and traders said S&P 500 futures buyers emerged once T-bonds closed.
